thread:
Noah: Idea: introduce a "confidence band" for autofallback decisions. Instead of a single threshold, policy evaluates a band (low/medium/high) and acts differently: sample, soft-reroute, full-reroute. This should reduce noisy toggles.

Priya: Nice. How do we surface that in console? Need a simple visual and clear dry_run behavior.

Noah: Sketch of config (YAML):

```
policy_id: cb-fallback-1
mode: confidence-band
bands:
  low: {action: monitor}
  medium: {action: sample, sample_rate: 0.05}
  high: {action: reroute}
triggers: [http_5xx, p95_latency, quality_drop]
hysteresis_s: 180
dry_run: true
audit: timeline, decision_hash, sampled_input_hash
```

Zoe: UX: per-policy band meter (like a 3-color gauge). Timeline should show band state over time and which requests were sampled. Add a "why" popover that lists top contributing signals when band moved.

Anil: Telemetry: emit tags rescue.policy_id, rescue.band, rescue.decision_action, rescue.estimated_cost_delta. Audit line must include decision_path and operator_override when present.

Priya: Simulation is key. Console needs a "replay with bands" button that re-runs traces and shows % in each band and projected cost. Dry_run on by default for new policies.

Noah: Also propose a decision fence: if a consumer has prefer_stable=true, band actions cap at sample_rate and will never auto-reroute without manual enable. Protects enterprise customers.

Zoe: For samples: sidecar stores sanitized inputs and returns sample_url_hash. Audit stores only the hash and reason_code. Retention default 90 days, configurable per-org. Must redact PII.

Anil: Edge case: overlapping policies. Add precedence + policy_group to resolve. If two policies hit same request, higher precedence wins; tie-breaker: created_at. Console should surface conflicts in a small banner.

OpsBot: ci/pipeline:policy-service/PR-842 -> staged :white_check_mark: https://ci.internal/PR-842

Priya: Small UX ask: when band flips rapidly, show an "oscillation warning" with suggested hysteresis tweak and a one-click "increase hysteresis" action that pre-fills a recommended value based on signal noise.

Noah: Good. Action items: (1) Noah: proto sketch + default dry_run true and decision examples, (2) Priya: console mock for band meter + replay + oscillation affordance, (3) Zoe: telemetry + audit schema, (4) Anil: precedence and prefer_stable semantics doc. I'll open a PR after mocks land.

Priya: Will mock the meter and replay tiles today. Keeping dry_run on for 14 days seems fine.

Zoe: Will draft telemetry fields and sample storage flow.

Anil: I'll write the precedence note and how it interacts with dedicated pools. If prefer_stable==true and fallback_target isn't dedicated, don't reroute.

Noah: Thanks all — linking PR when ready.
